question: Does the publicly accessible original Xu-An NLC08938 juan37 separately print the same two 820 arithmetic roles as Xing's previously reviewed original NLC-CBM1408 juan37, without interpreting either as a G893 historical numeric final or an original ji-jiefa formula?

prior_comparator.comparison: Xu-An p28 and Xing p64 show the same two different 820 arithmetic roles and named 遲疾限下行度 divisor in their own scanned printed source pages. This is source-original cross-accession wording corroboration, NOT independent-plate certification, same-physical-copy identity or numeric source-table equivalence.

limitations: Both source originals are different catalogued acquisition routes, but their printing-plate independence, exact impression dates and direct stemmatic relationship are not authenticated.
Xu-An juan37 original p24–30 and first-pass contact atlas are not a 67-page exhaustive line-by-line collation.
The two 820 roles are separate procedural operators; neither directly establishes juan45 second table's 疾-specific 捷法 coefficient construction or a universal precision/rounding rule.
No second-table L132 二/三 final, G893 matching degree/time field, source-original 少/微 carry or six-control historical final is awarded.
No new original PDF bytes or scan crops are published into GitHub; retain only source URL, public GitHub workflow IDs and digest-bound derived evidence.
next_action: Focus on independent legible Xu-An juan45 second-table L132 damaged 二/三 and a directly printed 疾 捷法 numerator/denominator plus 少/微 radix/carry at matching fields. Avoid recollating the now-confirmed juan37 820 operator distinction; preserve TW-OPEN-0005 P0 OPEN.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Same original juan37 operator wording in NLC08938 and NLC-CBM1408 does not prove direct text copying, independent printing plates, or numeric identity with original G893 table fields.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Are Xu-An and Xing juan37/45 target leaves copied from a common printing block or from separately edited plates?
